long_biography.plain_text:
In 2014, Yoshiro Hirayu attended the first Taiwan International Boat Show in Kaohsiung as a buyer from Japan. He acquired the largest craft on display, reported to have cost NT$330 million to build. At the show, Hirayu said he had already purchased three Taiwan-built boats, signalling an established relationship with the country's builders.

The event showcased Taiwan's manufacturing sector to an international audience, drawing more than 2,000 overseas buyers during its first three days. Hirayu singled out the quality of the boats and the enthusiasm of local visitors. His remarks captured two sides of the inaugural show: the commercial appeal of Taiwanese craftsmanship to repeat foreign customers and the strong public interest surrounding the exhibition. He said the reception in Kaohsiung had left a lasting impression.
